title: Productionization / Lot45 Pilot
objective: Pilot the completed Development Engine against the suspended Lot45 candidate without mutating business code, identify engine/workflow redundancies or defects, certify Development Engine V1, freeze its bootstrap interfaces, and only then make an explicit business-development unlock decision.
forbidden_scope: Lot45 candidate branch mutation during ENG-09.1 pilot
Lot46 implementation or unlock before ENG-09.6 decision

tasks.description: Run the Development Engine read-only against the suspended Lot45 candidate and record exact-head pilot evidence.
Identify redundant workflows, reviews and validation work exposed by the Lot45 pilot.
Repair engine defects found by the pilot, including terminal engineering-lifecycle semantics if required.
Certify Development Engine V1 with exact-head SAFE, FAST, zero-cost and security evidence.
Freeze V1 bootstrap interfaces and permanent agent entry points.
Explicitly decide whether business development may be unlocked; never auto-unlock.

done_when: Lot45 candidate has been exercised by the engine without candidate mutation
workflow and review redundancies are measured and addressed or explicitly accepted
pilot-discovered engine defects are repaired and regression-qualified
Development Engine V1 receives exact-head SAFE FAST zero-cost security certification
V1 bootstrap interfaces are frozen and documented
business-development unlock is an explicit fail-closed decision that cannot bypass BOOT-FINDING-001 or other blockers
